pages.title: Read the situation
pages.instruction: Read for the facts and the different priorities
pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: The woman who’s dancing with Leo
paragraphs: Fictional celebration cards: Alex, host, green shirt beside drinks table. Nina, guest, organised music, near dance floor. Leo is a known character in the scene; no new job, age or family relationship is assigned to him.

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Who’s the woman who’s dancing with Leo?
lines.audioText: Who’s the woman who’s dancing with Leo?
lines.translation: Quem é a mulher que está dançando com o Leo?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: That’s Nina. She helped organise the party
lines.audioText: That’s Nina. She helped organise the party.
lines.translation: É a Nina. Ela ajudou a organizar a festa

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Is she the person who organised the music?
lines.audioText: Is she the person who organised the music?
lines.translation: Ela é a pessoa que organizou a música?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes. And the person in the green shirt by the table is Alex, the host
lines.audioText: Yes. And the person in the green shirt by the table is Alex, the host.
lines.translation: Sim. E a pessoa de camisa verde perto da mesa é Alex, que está recebendo os convidados

questions.answer: The woman dancing with Leo is Nina
Alex is the host in the green shirt by the table

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I’d like to thank Alex. Which table do you mean?
lines.audioText: I’d like to thank Alex. Which table do you mean?
lines.translation: Gostaria de agradecer ao Alex. De qual mesa você está falando?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The table where the drinks are. It’s next to the dance floor
lines.audioText: The table where the drinks are. It’s next to the dance floor.
lines.translation: A mesa onde estão as bebidas. Fica ao lado da pista de dança

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Great. Could you introduce us? I don’t want to interrupt the speech
lines.audioText: Great. Could you introduce us? I don’t want to interrupt the speech.
lines.translation: Ótimo. Pode nos apresentar? Não quero interromper o discurso

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Of course. Let’s wait until it finishes, then I’ll take you over
lines.audioText: Of course. Let’s wait until it finishes, then I’ll take you over.
lines.translation: Claro. Vamos esperar terminar e depois acompanho você

questions.answer: Ana means the drinks table next to the dance floor

questions.prompt: Why don’t they approach Alex immediately?
questions.answer: They don’t want to interrupt the speech

questions.prompt: What will they do after the speech?
questions.answer: Ana will take Kim over and introduce her to Alex

pages.title: Introduce us
pages.instruction: Help me find the person and introduce us

pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: Look for the host. Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. Before you introduce me at our example celebration, could you help me find Alex? Alex is the host, the person in the green shirt standing by the drinks table. I don’t mean Nina, who organised the music and is near the dance floor. The speech is almost finished, so we can go over afterwards. Please introduce me using the facts on Alex’s card rather than guessing a job or a family relationship
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. Before you introduce me at our example celebration, could you help me find Alex? Alex is the host, the person in the green shirt standing by the drinks table. I don’t mean Nina, who organised the music and is near the dance floor. The speech is almost finished, so we can go over afterwards. Please introduce me using the facts on Alex’s card rather than guessing a job or a family relationship.
pages.greeting: Could you help me find the host?

items.prompt: Who does Kim want help finding?

items.answer: Alex is standing by the drinks table

items.prompt: What should the introduction avoid guessing?
items.answer: The introduction should not guess Alex’s job or family relationship
